implementation_notes: Paper specifies angular velocity 0.5 rad/s; this engine takes per-step heading increments, hence 0.05 rad at dt=0.1.
Energy is excluded from policy observations; 54 features contain own position/velocity/heading and 6 neighbors of each species.
Fixed predators use the exact wrapped bearing error with the angular limit, and maximum forward propulsion; only prey learn.
Speed is capped by vector norm in this experiment; wall damping is disabled because the paper includes elastic contact and aerodynamic drag.
Body radii are not specified in the paper tables; repository defaults are retained.
Random-action distribution is unspecified; retain the existing per-agent uniform replacement interpretation of epsilon exploration.
No separate random warmup is specified; start learning when the prey replay has a full minibatch.
Use the existing simulator integration/contact timing; this is parameter-aligned experimentation, not a claim of bit-exact reproduction of the authors' run.
Evaluation length, seed, checkpoint frequency and fused Adam/CUDA Graph are implementation choices, not paper hyperparameters.
